Nagaland to host first Indian Football League match on Nov 14 
 By MOKOKCHUNG TIMES 
Nov 10, 2026 
 #Football , #Gokulam , #IFL , #IndianFootball , #Kerala , #Nagaland , #NUSC Nagaland United SC to face Gokulam Kerala FC in its first home fixture at Chümoukedima Football Stadium 
 Nagaland will host its first-ever Indian Football League (IFL) match on November 14, when Nagaland United Sports Club (NUSC) takes on Gokulam Kerala FC at the Chümoukedima Football Stadium.
 The match, scheduled to kick off at 6:30 pm, will be NUSC’s first home fixture of the season and the first IFL match to be played in the state.
 NUSC, the first club from Nagaland to compete in the IFL, will look to build on its opening performance after registering a 3-1 victory over Real Kashmir FC on October 30. The team will now face Kerala-based Gokulam Kerala FC in front of its home supporters.
 The fixture marks a new milestone for football in Nagaland, bringing a professional national-level league match to the state and giving local supporters an opportunity to watch IFL action on home ground.
 The club has invited football fans and supporters from across the state to attend the match and support the team.
 Tickets are available online at www.ahibi.in.
 Match details: Nagaland United SC vs Gokulam Kerala FC; November 14, 2026; 6:30 pm; Chümoukedima Football Stadium.
